verdict.rationale: Whether a hosted sandbox platform uses customer data for AI training is a fair privacy question for a cloud service, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no training opt-out, data-usage policy, or no-training commitment. The isolation docs (VM/container isolation) cover a different security capability and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
